users.title: User
users.description: App users including super admins and regular users with login credentials, full name, email, and IP tracking.

username.description: Unique username used for system login.

ipAddress.description: User IP address recorded during registration or last activity.

role.description: User authority role (e.g., super_admin or user).

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the user record was created.

app_settings.title: AppSettings
app_settings.description: Global application configurations like column visibility and locks managed by Super Admin.

lockedColumns.description: Map of locked column keys by super admin.

superAdminHiddenColumns.description: Map of columns super admin forced hidden for regular users.

smsTemplateStyle.description: Active SMS template design style (cards, chat, compact).

device_sessions.title: DeviceSessions
device_sessions.description: Active user devices and session details including device name (e.g., Infinix Note 30), browser, OS, IP address, location, and control status.

device_notifications.title: DeviceNotifications
device_notifications.description: Direct message and security warnings sent to devices by Super Admin.
